established.conditional_target: if one integer occurrence may be charged, L=A*q_perp and c=-q_perp^{-1} mod p give a deterministic overflow shape with c<=p-2

not_established.integer_occurrence: no theorem puts q_perp on a specific raw source side/path above current K capacity
